defects: The epi hypothesis is placed on the wrong morphism: `Epi m_gh` is an edge *of* the missing (top) face itself (g → h, one of the two composite legs whose equality is being proved), not an edge crossing into the missing face from outside the cube. In the gold statement, the epi (`f00x`) is on a 'vertical' edge that maps into the source vertex of the sixth face from the opposite face (analogous to `m_ae` in the produced labeling), which is what makes the epi-cancellation argument work.

Because of this misplacement, the produced statement is not even a true theorem: a concrete counterexample in Set (a=b=c=d singleton, e=f={0,1}, g=h={p,q} with m_gh=id, and appropriately chosen maps) satisfies all five commuting-face hypotheses and Epi m_gh, yet the sixth face fails to commute (m_ef≫m_fh sends both elements to p, while m_eg≫m_gh sends 0↦p,1↦q). So the produced statement asserts a false proposition, unlike the gold statement which is a valid theorem.
Consequently the produced statement is not merely a relabeling of gold's hypotheses/conclusion but expresses a different (and incorrect) mathematical claim.
